description: mcp.server.inspect runs a CANDIDATE server's command, completes initialize + tools/list (never tools/call) and stops it, answering what the server says it is and every tool it offers: name, description, input schema and the annotation hints. Nothing is stored and no audit row is made. A human door: the peer stamp is required before anything runs. The environment travels as NAMES; their values come from the daemon's own environment unless `useVariables` is true, in which case the stored variables are used — opt-in, because the command is whatever the person typed. The hints are the server's own report, never a classification: only the person's configuration classifies a tool.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List the repositories the token can see.
